Structured search with filters

Source: R/search.R
sq_search_structured.Rd

Advanced search combining free-text query with structured filters.

sq_search_structured(
  con,
  query = NULL,
  organism = NULL,
  library_strategy = NULL,
  platform = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  center = NULL,
  year_from = NULL,
  year_to = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  journal = NULL,
  instrument_model = NULL,
  sortby = NULL,
  order = "desc",
  assay_l1 = NULL,
  assay_l2 = NULL,
  geo_country = NULL,
  geo_country_code = NULL,
  geo_city = NULL,
  geo_state = NULL,
  geo_district = NULL,
  geo_postcode = NULL,
  geo_lat = NULL,
  geo_lng = NULL,
  geo_radius_km = NULL,
  cursor_rank = NULL,
  cursor_acc = NULL,
  cursor_sort = NULL,
  max_pages = 1
)

Arguments

con

A seqout_connection from connect_seqout().

query

Character. Search query string.

organism

Filter by scientific name (e.g., "Homo sapiens").

library_strategy

Filter by library strategy (e.g., "RNA-Seq").

platform

Filter by sequencing platform.

country

Filter by country name.

center

Filter by sequencing center.

year_from, year_to

Filter by publication year range.

source

Filter by source database.

journal

Filter by journal name.

instrument_model

Filter by instrument model.

sortby

Optional. Sort results by "citations", "journal", or "year".

order

Sort order: "desc" (default) or "asc".

assay_l1, assay_l2

Filter by assay level 1 or 2 classification.

geo_country, geo_country_code

Filter by geographic country.

geo_city, geo_state, geo_district, geo_postcode

Geographic filters.

geo_lat, geo_lng, geo_radius_km

Geographic radius search.

cursor_rank, cursor_acc, cursor_sort

Pagination cursors from a previous result's next_cursor.

max_pages

Maximum number of pages to fetch. Defaults to 1. Set to Inf to fetch all results (use with care).

Value

A tibble of search results.
